data.name: Dwarf
data.description:
The Alliance - Dwarf [W]
Units:
+2 armor
+10% hit points
-10% attack speed

Buildings:
+10% hit points
Barracks attacks bounce once (35% dmg loss)

Upgrades:
+2Lv Building Armor

Magic:
Rune Engraving (casts a random unlocked rune, up to 3 charges)
Rune #1 Heals one organic unit for 90-150 HP
Rune #2 Shield on friendly unit, blocks 90-150 magic damage
Rune #3 +20% AS to friendly unit for 60-120 sec
Rune #4 Deals 30 dmg and stuns 3-5 times in 250 AoE
Rune #5 Summons Spirit with aura for 15 sec
(+3 HP/sec / +20% damage / +15% AS)

Traits: What they lack in magic and spells, Dwarves make it up in their ingenuity. Weak starting units, but powerful late game mechanical contraptions that are resistant to almost all magic effects.

Difficulty: Nightmare
Created: by Balkron

bonuses.name: Forge [C]
bonuses.description:
Lets you forge your own Golems

Pick Type, Template, Material, Core and Rune in the Golem Workshop and press Craft (costs the recipe mana; the Forge stops regenerating mana until the golem is released).
Then release the golem from the barrack you choose (Sapphire Core: from every barrack, Amethyst Core: at a point near your units).
Crafting without enough mana makes a defective golem (-40% stats) and all your buildings take 1000 damage.
The Forge stores up to 100 mana and regenerates 0.50 per second (more with the Runic Furnace research).
Only the first two options of every row are open; each Runic Furnace level opens one more.

Type: Unique Bonus
